description: Build a reusable editing style from one reference video shared by link or file. mode clone (the default) is the deep copy: it measures the reference and writes its own captions and motion; the linked account includes style copies every month at no credit cost, and once they are used each costs 25 credits. mode match is the fast copy: it maps the reference onto Clypmint's own devices in a few minutes, is included for every account and is approximate. A copy that is still working or has stopped shows in browse_styles (with its time left, or why it stopped and how to try again). dry_run: true answers whether this one is included (and how many are left) or what it costs, and starts nothing.

dry_run.description: true: answer the cost and start nothing.

format.description: What the reference is: talking (a person on camera), faceless (a voice over pictures) or motion (graphics and music).

mode.description: clone (default): deep, copies the reference's own motion and captions; slower; uses a monthly style copy, then credits. match: fast and approximate; included for every account.

name.description: A name for the new style.

operation_id.description: The same id on a retry runs it once; a new id is a new request.

reference.description: The reference video attached in ChatGPT, instead of a link.

reference_url.description: A public link to the reference video (Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Loom or LinkedIn). Send this or reference.

name: copy_style

outputSchema.description: Clypmint copy_style result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Make an editing style
